name: Yucca

project_scope.note: B004 established the original four-species comparison; B082 added Y. arkansana and provisional Y. pallida. The source spelling Yucca treculeana is represented by canonical Yucca treculiana and is not a separate learner concept.

shared_traits: large pendent cream to greenish-white flowers
fruit type, leaf margins, and rosette/trunk habit are highly diagnostic
priority: leaf width, stiffness, color, and flexibility
dry dehiscent capsule versus fleshy indehiscent fruit
study_strategy.warning: Do not identify the tree yuccas Y. torreyi and Y. treculiana from one leaf character alone; older taxonomic lumping and overlap make multi-character confirmation important. Keep Y. pallida's range HOLD separate from morphology confidence.

quick_key.if: low stemless rosette with narrow flexible dull-green leaves and conspicuous white curly marginal fibers; flower stalk simple or sparsely branched
low trunkless colony with broad flexible strongly glaucous blue-gray leaves, yellowish margins, and weak/absent curly fibers
trunkless colony; broad flexible leaves conspicuously twisted with orange/red wavy-toothed margins
trunkless/short-stemmed colony; very narrow mostly straight leaves with white marginal threads and deeply waist-constricted dry capsule
tree yucca; traditionally marginal threads and often inrolled leaf tips; fleshy fruit
tree yucca; traditionally few/no marginal threads, leaf tips not strongly inrolled; stouter ovary and fleshy fruit; older/source spelling often 'treculeana'

source_concept_status.note: Two exact target-zone counties locked; native metrics excluded pending a third county.

taxonomy_note: Current Kew/POWO accepts Yucca treculiana Carrière. The project preserves the source-pool spelling Yucca treculeana for provenance/older literature but maps it to the single canonical Y. treculiana learner. Current Kew also keeps Yucca torreyi distinct, while older treatments may lump it.
